notes: Officially named "IntelliMix P300 Audio Conferencing Processor" (not a "Personal Monitor Mixer" — that naming does not correspond to a real Shure product). Sourced directly from Shure's official P300 User Guide (v7.1, 2020-I): https://www.shure.com/en-US/docs/guide/P300 (PDF mirror used for extraction: https://www.avc-group.com/assets/products/Shure/pdfs/shure-um-intellimix_p300.pdf). Analog audio in/out are each physically presented as a single 3-pin captive block connector pair per channel (2 input channels, 2 output channels) — modeled here as 2 separate input ports and 2 separate output ports, each euroblock, balanced. Mobile 3.5mm TRRS jack is functionally bidirectional (stereo input on tip/ring1, mono send-to-phone on sleeve) but is a combo in/out signal, not a host/device link, so it is modeled with direction "bidirectional" and connector trs-3.5 (closest match; device is a 4-conductor TRRS, not plain TRS — "accepts" left empty as TRRS is not in the provided connector list). USB port is USB 2.0 Type-B, bidirectional (2 in / 2 out channels, summed mono), carrying audio only — no defined USB grade beyond 2.0 in spec sheet, so grade set to usb-2.0. Dante/RJ45 port supports 10 Dante inputs and 8 Dante outputs logically over the single physical RJ45 (48kHz/24-bit, AES67 compatible) plus PoE+ (802.3at Type 2, Class 4) — grade left as eth-1g since Dante over standard RJ45 typically runs at Gigabit and the spec doesn't state a different Ethernet PHY speed (inferred, not explicitly stated as "1000BASE-T" in the guide, hence overall confidence kept high but this specific grade is a reasonable inference). Chassis ground screw omitted (not a cabled port). Device is a compact desktop/under-table unit, not natively 1U rack — mounts via included single-unit under-table tray or optional CRT1 19" rack tray (holds 2 units); rackUnits omitted accordingly. Dimensions: 4 x 21 x 22.6 cm (1.6 x 8.3 x 8.9 in), weight 1710 g.
